title: record page: two security/explain verdicts (update, delete) are asked for affordances the object already hides (userActions edit: false, delete: false)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 round 6 (dev report `6266910210`). ⛔ Not a claim: the objectui lane dispatches it.

**How it was measured:**
- The rig ran cloud `eca60c38` (framework `fb9c22aa`, objectui `47508f3b`) on `run-stack --prod-like --with-ui --seed`.
- The subject was an ordinary organization owner. Each page got one warm-up, then 8 full warm opens, counted from the page's performance entries.
- Producers were found from CDP initiator stacks, mapped through a hidden-sourcemap build that is byte-identical to the served console.
- The maintainer's staging reading `6265264751` shows the same duplicate paths.

## What was measured (8/8 opens)

A full open of an environment's record page (`sys_environment/record/ID`) sends `POST /api/v1/security/explain` twice to one URL:
- **The two bodies:** `{object: sys_environment, operation: update, recordId}`, and the same with `operation: delete`.
- **Where they come from:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1752` and `:1758`, through `plugin-detail` `src/useRecordEditable.ts:235` (`askVerdict`).
- **Why they are wasted:** `sys_environment` declares `userActions` `edit: false` and `delete: false` (cloud `packages/service-tenant/src/objects/sys-environment.object.ts:241`). The header already hides both affordances, so both verdicts gate nothing the user can see.
- **When:** both land before the first paint (1074–1105 ms of a 1107 ms splash on the rig). The performance entries carry no method or body, so objectstack-ai/cloud#2914's measure counts the pair as one duplicate URL.

## Target

The record page skips the verdict for an operation the object's `userActions` already turns off.

## Acceptance

- One full open of a `sys_environment` record sends no `security/explain`.
- An object with `userActions` on still asks, and its affordances follow the verdict, as today.
- Tests for both, with an ablation.
